blocks.x: Open roles at Achala IT Solutions — delivery engineering across applied AI, data platforms, security, edge and cloud. Every listing names the team, the stack and the interview loop before you apply.

One conversation with the hiring lead, one technical deep-dive on real artifacts (not whiteboard puzzles), one working session with the prospective pod, and an offer or a no inside two weeks. Feedback is written either way.

Data and platform engineers, AI/ML engineers with production scars, security engineers who think in identity rather than firewalls, SRE-minded platform builders, and delivery leads who can still read the code.
Evidence of craft: systems you designed, incidents you handled, quality of the runbooks you left behind. Depth in one tower plus curiosity across others beats shallow breadth.
Apply through the careers inbox with a CV and one artifact you are proud of — a design doc, a repository, a post-mortem you wrote. That artifact starts the conversation.
If the way we work reads like the way you work, careers@achalasolutions.com is the door — bring an artifact, not a cover letter.
